articles.title: Cisco (CSCO) Stock Lags Record Q1 Earnings As AI Revenue Builds
articles.summary: Cisco Systems just posted Q1 FY2027 numbers that read like a victory lap, while the stock is only inching higher. Shares closed at US$97.18, up 2.2% on the day, even as the networking giant delivered record quarterly revenue of US$18.5b and non GAAP earnings per share of US$1.40. That gap between a modest price move and a very strong earnings print is the story. The market is reacting, but not as dramatically as the fundamentals might suggest. articles.title: Why Analysts Are Suddenly Talking About This Forgotten Tech Stock
articles.summary: Cisco just posted a record quarter, and the stock still sank. Behind the selloff sits an AI networking bet, a margin squeeze, and a valuation gap with Arista that has some analysts rethinking what this old dividend payer is really worth.
